notes.title: Climbing bug fix
notes.notes: There was an error while playing with controller. No action was performed when you pressed south button while princess was on the ladder, while when space was pressed princess was climbing/jumping.

notes.title: 3dconnexion issues
notes.notes:
I received information about issues with the game after installing drivers from the following site:
https://3dconnexion.com/pl/drivers/

The error was that only the Princess could move, and it was not possible to control the Knight. The control system has been rebuilt, and on my local resources, the problem no longer occurs.

You can start testing!

notes.title: New Features and Fixes
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce a new update! Here’s what we have prepared for you:

New Translation: The game is now available in Russian! This means that even more players can enjoy the full experience of our game in their native language.
Bug Fixes: Various fixes have been implemented to improve gameplay and enhance the stability of the game. Thank you for all your reports and suggestions – your feedback is incredibly valuable to us.
We hope these changes will make your adventure with our game even more enjoyable. Thank you for your support and have fun playing!

notes.title: Gamepad fix
notes.notes:
- steering speed fix
- pause menu support
- pause menu show/hide on gamepad disconnect/reconnect

notes.title: Checkpoints
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings testers[/b]
A new feature has been added to the game. Depending on the selected difficulty level, checkpoints may appear on some levels. This is a nod to less patient players so they can also enjoy the game. Of course, at the highest difficulty level, we won't encounter any checkpoints.

Happy testing!
